name: same-score-pair-teleport
description: One pulse block teleports the nearby registered trigger player to the other registered online player when both scores match.

blocks.command: execute as @a[tag=teleport_eligible,r=3,c=1] at @s at @a[tag=teleport_eligible,rm=0.1] if score @s pair_score = @p pair_score run tp @s @p
blocks.note: Register only A and B. @p is a positional approximation for the button presser.

tests: A and B online with equal scores: trigger player teleports to the other player.
A third tagged player nearby: reject this configuration because ownership becomes ambiguous.
notes: Replace A and B with the actual player names for the test setup.
Static-only until executed on the target NetEase client.
